title: Stasis Garden
description: A surreal night scene features a masked woman in a robe seated in an ornate chair on a cracked stone patio, holding a film reel while another unwinds at her feet. Behind her, a body of water with lily pads reflects moonlight, leading to classical ruins, a large projection screen displaying a circular emblem, and a silhouetted figure standing in the water.
prompt: Surreal night scene with a masked woman in a silk robe seated in an ornate chair on a cracked stone patio overlooking a reflective body of water. She holds a film reel as another spills at her feet. Behind her are classical vine-covered ruins, lily pads, floating candles, potion bottles, an open book, and a large projection screen in the distance showing a circular emblem. A lone silhouetted figure stands in the water under a dramatic beam of light from above, mysterious and cinematic atmosphere, rich colors and intricate details.
